eventMetadata.context_description:
**Marine air influence and modest daytime heating are keeping Seattle's August 16 high temperature tightly contested between the low- and mid-70s.** Official National Weather Service guidance and local observations point to a peak near 76–78°F under mostly sunny to partly cloudy skies, yet persistent onshore flow from the cool Pacific keeps readings moderated, especially near Puget Sound and at Sea-Tac airport. This typical late-summer pattern—light winds, marine layer effects, and limited upper-level warming—explains why traders assign nearly equal weight to the 72–73°F and 74–75°F bins while assigning only single-digit probability to 76°F or higher. 

Any late-day clearing or slight wind shift could push the maximum into the upper 70s, but current model consensus and morning observations favor the lower side of the forecast range, creating the close market split.

This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport Station in degrees Celsius on 18 Aug '26.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: PAGASA's latest guidance positions a 29°C high as the most likely outcome for Manila on August 18 amid active southwest monsoon (habagat) flow, which sustains cloudy skies, scattered thunderstorms, and elevated humidity that limit daytime heating. Recent station data show highs of 30–30.5°C earlier in the period, but persistent monsoon moisture and cloud cover have trimmed peaks, aligning with the market's tight clustering around 28–29°C. Official outlooks through midweek maintain similar conditions with minimal model spread, though any break in convective activity could briefly allow readings to edge higher before the next surge. Traders appear to weigh these monsoon-driven constraints against the seasonal August average near 31°C.
